actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The werewyvern makes three attacks, using Javelin or Rend in any combination. It can replace one of these attacks with one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Javelin (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger (Wyvern or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the werewyvern's next turn. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Werewyvern under the DM's control and has 20 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this werewyvern's curse for 24 hours.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.desc: The werewyvern shape-shifts into a Medium wyvern-humanoid hybrid or a Large wyvern, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

sb.name: Young Deep Dragon
sb.speed: 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
sb.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 150 ft., passive Perception 18

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Nightmare Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 22 (4d10) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of the dragon's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

sb.name: Young Spirit Dragon
sb.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 15

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Time-Warping Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Ruinous Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Time-Warping Breath
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature that isn't currently affected by this breath in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target's Speed is halved, it can't take Reactions, and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.desc: Creatures in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the Zhentilar have their Speeds halved while in the Emanation. The Zhentilar can designate creatures to be unaffected by the aura.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Zhentilar makes three attacks, using Dooming Blade or Oppressive Ray in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Dooming Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Oppressive Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 90 ft. Hit: 16 (3d10) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The Zhentilar casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Command|Command]], [[Tools/Spells/Fear|Fear]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Zhentilar makes two attacks, using Shortsword or Pistol in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Knock Down.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Knock Down
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature within 5 feet that the Zhentilar can see. Failure: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

sb.name: Zlan

traits.name: Chardalyn Sense
traits.desc: Zlan senses the emotions of anyone touching a piece of chardalyn within 100 miles of itself.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Zlan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zlan has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Next of the Seven (6/Year)
traits.desc: If Zlan dies within 100 miles of a piece of chardalyn at least 4 inches long, it re-forms from that piece of chardalyn in 1d10 days, regaining all its Hit Points. The new body appears in the unoccupied space nearest to the piece of chardalyn, and another lich's mind in the body seizes psychic control of the body.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zlan makes three attacks, using Slam or Bewildering Bolt in any combination. It can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (3d4 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bewildering Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 120 ft. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Zlan casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|Message]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|Dimension Door]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|Fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Befuddlement|Befuddlement]], [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|Disintegrate]]

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.desc: Zlan casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Retaliation
legendary_actions.desc: Zlan makes one Slam or Bewildering Bolt attack.

legendary_actions.name: Stoke Paranoia
legendary_actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature Zlan can see within 30 feet (with Disadvantage if the target is holding or wearing chardalyn). Failure: 27 (6d8) Psychic damage and the target has the Charmed condition for 1 minute or until Zlan dies. While Charmed, the target doesn't act as an ally to any creature. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Zlan can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.
